name: Yoga school in Dublin
reason: No usable school found in three searches. Results were almost all directories (BookRetreats, Yoga Alliance Professionals, Retreat Guru) or booking pages (Punchpass, Ticketbud). Mandala Yoga Dublin showed only a Punchpass booking site and an informal 'Teaching Circle', with no own website or current training confirmed; Init Yoga and Hot Yoga Dublin (hot-yoga, out of scope) had no current own-site training found. Nearby schools (ālaya wellbeing in Cork, Aruna Yoga near Maynooth) are outside Dublin.
